title: Phát âm & Shadowing — Mệnh đề tính từ

sentences.text: Employees who work night shifts at the factory receive an extra allowance every month.
Doctors who work in rural clinics often treat more patients than their city colleagues do.
A diet that contains too much salt and sugar clearly raises the risk of diabetes.
The company which built the new terminal has apologised for the long delay to passengers.
The hotel which my parents chose stands right beside the old market in Hue.
The candidate whom the panel appointed starts work at the ministry early next Monday morning.
The equipment which the hospital ordered in January has still not arrived at the district clinic.
Most of the vegetables we eat are grown within thirty kilometres of the city centre.
The flat my sister rents stands only ten minutes from the nearest metro station.
The training the company offered me last summer covered almost nothing about health and safety.
Teachers who work in remote provinces receive an extra allowance from the ministry every month.
The report, which criticised the road plan, was quietly withdrawn from the website last month.
The small town where my grandparents live still has no hospital and no secondary school.
The district where flooding is worst has received almost no investment from the province.
The years when the economy grew fastest were also the years of the worst air pollution.
